value.rationale: The 2026 paper explicitly compares separately the unenvied and top-choice groups to assess market envy and efficiency. Their distinct-membership overlap is not captured by separate expected counts. The new finite bivariate law, all-n covariance and exact union expectation supply a natural, previously unreported simultaneous fairness benchmark without relabeling a marginal or introducing arbitrary parameters. The theorem does not overstate significance as a statement about Pareto-unimprovability.
